# bioexcel/biobb_amber/parmed_cpinutil

## Summary

Wrapper of the AmberTools (AMBER MD Package) parmed tool module.

Creates a cpin file for constant pH simulations from an AMBER topology file using parmed tool from the AmberTools MD package.

Nextflow adapter of the [ParmedCpinUtil](https://biobb-amber.readthedocs.io/en/latest/parmed.html#module-parmed.parmed_cpinutil) building block of [biobb_amber](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber) 5.3.3.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_AMBER_PARMED_CPINUTIL } from 'bioexcel/biobb_amber/parmed_cpinutil'

workflow {
    BIOBB_AMBER_PARMED_CPINUTIL(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_top_path` | yes | top, parmtop, prmtop | Input AMBER topology file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_cpin_path` | yes | cpin | Output AMBER constant pH input (CPin) file |
| `output_top_path` | no, opt-in | top, parmtop, prmtop | Output topology file (AMBER ParmTop) |
| `versions_biobb_amber` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_amber', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of ParmedCpinUtil properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_top_path: 'top']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_amber container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_AMBER_PARMED_CPINUTIL' {
        ext.properties = [resnames: 'AS4']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resnames` | string | "None" | Residue names to include in CPIN file. Values: AS4, GL4, HIP, CYS, LYS, TYR. |
| `igb` | integer | 2 | Generalized Born model which you intend to use to evaluate dynamics or protonation state swaps. Values: 1, 2, 5, 7, 8. |
| `system` | string | "Unknown" | Name of system to titrate. |
| `binary_path` | string | "cpinutil.py" | Path to the cpinutil.py executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
